name: TwoTrees TTS-55 Pro 10W
tagline: 10W Upgraded TTS frame with better rigidity and fixed focus
tldr: TwoTrees TTS-55 Pro 10W is the 10W SKU on the TwoTrees two trees tts 55 pro line. The TTS-55 Pro improves on the base TTS-55 with stiffer frame and easier focus workflow. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

priceRange.note: 10W optical module: verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Nearly doubles the original TTS-55 Pro's 5.5W while keeping the compact 300 × 300 mm frame
Fill speeds of 15–34 mm/s in our tests: ~18–28 min for a 10 × 10 cm photo
~0.09 mm spot, finer than the 20W tier on the same frame
cons: Small 300 × 300 mm bed limits sign and panel sizes unless you add TwoTrees' 600 × 600 mm extension kit ($89)
Cutting stays slow: ~9–15 min for a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood in our benchmark
Thin basswood only in our profile, with multiple passes beyond 3 mm
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W SKU on TwoTrees TTS-55 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

editorialDepth.advantages: TwoTrees TTS-55 Pro 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production: see 20W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: What is the TTS-55 Pro 10W exactly?
faq.answer: The TTS-55 Pro launched with a 5.5W laser. The 10W version uses the same 300 × 300 mm frame with a stronger module; TwoTrees also sells the TTS-10 Pro as its current 10W machine in this family. Check which module the listing actually ships with before buying.

faq.question: How thick can it cut with the 10W module?
faq.answer: TwoTrees publishes no per-pass chart for this tier. Our profile lists thin basswood in several passes, plus card and fabric, and our 3 mm basswood test square takes ~9–15 min at 2–3 mm/s.

faq.question: 10W or 20W on the TTS-55 Pro?
faq.answer: Keep the 10W ($249–379) for engraving gifts and occasional thin cuts. The 20W cuts our 3 mm test square in ~6–10 min and reaches 8 mm basswood; TwoTrees sells that 20W module separately for $359 (October 2026), so buying it built-in is usually cheaper than upgrading later.

standoutFeatures.title: Compact 300 × 300 mm frame
standoutFeatures.body: Fits on a small desk and is easier to enclose than 400 mm-class machines; a 600 × 600 mm extension kit is available ($89).

standoutFeatures.title: Finer spot than the 20W
standoutFeatures.body: ~0.09 mm in our profile against ~0.10 mm on the 20W tier, which helps on photos and small lettering.
